posts.title: Debugging surfaces in complex web applications
posts.description: Complex web applications hide themselves. Conditional logic, dynamic state, and multi-step flows mean that most of the UI is invisible. Debugging surfaces bring it back into view, and they benefit developers, reviewers, and stakeholders alike.
